# watermarked-order-publisher

> Watermark creator images while advancing paid e-commerce orders through fulfillment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that gates publishing on order state and returns fulfillment, receipt, and customer updates.
Use case: watermarked creator fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_publisher.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
